title: Test gate command substring filter excludes address_assignment_vectors integration suite
description: cargo test -p lichen-rpl address_assignment matches 13 lib unit tests but 0 of tests/address_assignment_vectors.rs whose names lack substring. Full suite requires --test address_assignment_vectors (26 passed combined, exit 0 verified). Update test-gate docs/CI invocation.
close_reason: Invocation string is documented nowhere outside .beads bookkeeping, so added module-level //! docs to tests/address_assignment_vectors.rs stating the required cargo test -p lichen-rpl --test address_assignment_vectors invocation and explaining that the substring filter skips the suite (verified: filter catches 13 lib tests + 0 of 13 vector tests; --test yields 13 passed).
